privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Welcome to TouchCraft. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and the Spanish Organic Law 3/2018 on the Protection of Personal Data and Guarantee of Digital Rights (LOPDGDD).

sec2.title: 2. Our Dual Role (Controller vs. Processor)
sec2.desc: Due to the nature of our SaaS website builder platform, we act in two different capacities:
sec2.li1: As a Data Controller: When you (the user) create an account on TouchCraft, purchase a subscription, or contact our support. We decide why and how your data is processed.
sec2.li2: As a Data Processor: When you use TouchCraft to host your website and collect information from your own clients (e.g., through Lead Forms on your generated website). In this case, you are the Data Controller of your clients' data, and we merely process and store it on your behalf. We will never use your clients' data for our own purposes.

sec3.title: 3. What Information We Collect and Why
sec3.r1c1: Account Data: Name, Email, Password, Auth0 Profile.
sec3.r1c2: To create and manage your account, provide access to the builder.
sec3.r2c1: Usage Data & Analytics: IP address, device info, GA4 data.
sec3.r2c2: To ensure platform security, prevent fraud, and analyze traffic to improve UI/UX.
sec3.r3c1: AI Prompts: Texts you input to generate websites.
sec3.r3c2: To generate code, translations, and images via third-party AI APIs.

sec4.title: 4. Third-Party Services & International Transfers
sec4.desc: We do not sell your personal data. However, to provide our Services, we share strictly necessary data with trusted third-party service providers:
sec4.li1: Google LLC (Gemini API & Google Analytics 4): Used for AI website generation and traffic analysis. Data may be transferred to the US under Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) and the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.
sec4.li2: Auth0: Used for secure user authentication and login management.
sec4.li3: Cloud Providers (e.g., DigitalOcean / AWS): Used for hosting your websites and our databases within European data centers where possible.

sec5.title: 5. Data Retention
sec5.desc: We retain your personal data only for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide you with the Services. If you request account deletion, we will delete your data within 30 days, except for data we are legally required to retain (e.g., invoices for tax purposes under Spanish law for up to 5 years).

sec6.title: 6. Your Rights (ARCO+ Rights)
sec6.desc: Under the GDPR and LOPDGDD, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
sec6.li1: Access: Request a copy of the data we hold about you.
sec6.li3: Erasure (Right to be Forgotten): Request deletion of your data when it is no longer necessary.
sec6.li4: Restriction: Ask us to suspend the processing of your data.
sec6.li5: Data Portability: Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
sec6.li6: Withdraw Consent: Withdraw your consent for non-essential cookies or newsletters at any time.
sec6.contact: To exercise these rights, email us at

sec7.title: 7. Right to Lodge a Complaint
sec7.desc: If you believe that your data protection rights have been violated, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (Agencia Española de Protección de Datos - AEPD).

sec8.title: 8. Cookies Policy
sec8.desc: We use essential cookies to maintain sessions (e.g., Auth0 authentication) and optional analytics cookies (Google Analytics 4). You can manage your preferences at any time using the Cookie settings banner located at the bottom of our website.
